Name: Sunny's Sanity Saver
Author: BigDipper4200
Description:
After the game saves each night, the player is returned to the main menu screen. If they decide to keep playing, they can reload their save and continue the next day. This break in gameplay is meant to give the player the opportunity to choose to stop playing, rather than continuing on autopilot. This check also prevents...incapacitated players from accidentally progressing years at a time while they snooze.

This mod is compatible with the Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM). The option to turn it off is [i]not persistent! [/i]This is an intentional decision, made to create as much friction as possible to prevent a particularly unmotivated player from becoming complacent. This means that even if you disable the exit-on-save functionality in one session, it will be re-enabled the next time you launch the game. You can also toggle this without the use of GMCM by entering "exit_on_save [on/off]" in the SMAPI Console.

Q: Could this lead to data corruption?
A: No. The exit-to-menu is only triggered when Events.GameLoop.Saved is triggered, making this a data safe solution. In other words, the code to exit to the menu will only run after the game confirms that data was saved successfully. 

This is my first Stardew Valley mod. If it has any bugs, let me know in a comment, and I'll fix them.
